create.name: Ramona Lisa Ortiz-Smith
create.bio:
Ramona Lisa Ortiz-Smith is a meditation teacher and mentor in the Theravada Buddhist tradition of insight (Vipassana) practice, with more than twenty-five years of practice behind her. Before her life in the Dharma she danced with Dance Theatre of Harlem, and she later took contemporary Upasika vows and spent several years living as a lay renunciate. She is part of the joint Insight Meditation Society and Spirit Rock teacher training that runs from 2025 to 2028, was one of five Black teachers chosen for the second Dharma Relief fellowship in 2023, and is a certified mindfulness teacher.

Her teaching roles include resident teacher at Assaya Sangha, an insight community for women around the Bay Area, a community teacher at East Bay Meditation Center, and an assistant teacher on silent retreats at IMS and Spirit Rock. Through her own practice, Free Spirit, she offers classes, daylongs, retreats and one-to-one mentoring, online and in person, and she holds a monthly sit for BIPOC women. Her teaching draws on her own life with warmth, humour and directness, and some of her talks and guided meditations can be watched online. She is based in Fairfax, in Marin County, California.
